SELECT t.id, t.name, COUNT(m.id) AS media_count, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM tag t LEFT JOIN media_tag mt ON mt.tag_id = t.id LEFT JOIN media m ON m.id = mt.media_id
t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')

SELECT 'TAG' AS type, t.id, t.name AS text, '标签' AS subtitle FROM tag t INNER JOIN media_tag mt ON mt.tag_id = t.id INNER JOIN ( SELECT ranked.id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ranked.favorite_count DESC, ranked.like_count DESC, ranked.view_count DESC, ranked.id DESC ) AS media_rank FROM media ranked INNER JOIN location ranked_l ON ranked_l.id = ranked.location_id AND ranked_l.status = 1 INNER JOIN campus ranked_c ON ranked_c.id = ranked_l.campus_id AND ranked_c.status = 1 INNER JOIN city ranked_ci ON ranked_ci.id = ranked_c.city_id AND ranked_ci.status = 1 WHERE ranked.status = 1
AND ( ranked.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ranked.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM media_tag keyword_mt INNER JOIN tag keyword_tag ON keyword_tag.id = keyword_mt.tag_id WHERE keyword_mt.media_id = ranked.id AND keyword_tag.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) )
ORDER BY ranked.favorite_count DESC, ranked.like_count DESC, ranked.view_count DESC, ranked.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) candidate ON candidate.id = mt.media_id
t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
GROUP BY t.id, t.name ORDER BY MIN(candidate.media_rank), MIN(mt.sort_order), t.id LIMIT #{limit}
